item.title: hanging at the Hayward 🖼️ @lindersterling to be including in your retrospective, wearing the same breastplate you wore when you were my age while ...
item.description:
hanging at the Hayward 🖼️ @lindersterling to be including in your retrospective, wearing the same breastplate you wore when you were my age while you were training is my own personal armor against the world. My protection!! the emotions I felt seeing this hanging there amongst all your inspiring and radical pieces was a lot to take in. thank you for making what I used to see as mess feel like art. thank you for seeing me as a piece of your story, because it’s one that I look up to and admire endlessly🤍

If yall are in London, GOOOO to the @hayward.gallery to see the Danger Came Calling retrospective on until May!
